description: Appends one or more section nodes to the end of an existing page's `page` array, server-side: only the new sections are sent, and the backend rejects element ids that already exist on the page. The sections are validated first. dry_run defaults to true: it validates, caches the payload under a draft_id and previews the request; dry_run:false appends. A validation failure also returns a draft_id, which patch_page accepts for element-level fixes. Section-level saves cannot change page settings, so font weights that need new font links are reported in font_weights_notice. Requires Webcake credentials.

draft_id.description: A draft id returned by a previous add_section call (dry_run=true or validation failure). Loads the cached section payload, so the sections are not re-sent.

dry_run.description: Default TRUE — validate the section(s) and preview the request without writing. Set false to actually append.

page_id.description: The page id to append to (from create_page or list_pages; must be owned by the account).

sections.description: One section node, or an array of section nodes, appended to the end of `page` (object/array or JSON string). Each is a normal section element { id, type:'section', responsive, children, … } with a unique id; sections stack vertically after the existing ones. Nodes may be sparse — omitted properties/runtime/empty events and children/per-breakpoint config are filled from factory defaults. Required unless draft_id is supplied.

name: add_section
